2608.24696.title: On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward
2608.24696.paper_summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD) have become two widely adopted paradigms for post-training large language models. However, RLVR suffers from sparse task-level feedback, while OPD provides dense token-level guidance but ignores trajectory correctness, limiting its performance to that of the teacher. Combining them is a promising direction: OPD supplies dense supervisory signals, while RLVR provides task-level correctness. Nevertheless, existing integrations often rely on weighted combination or heuristic switching, introducing extra hyperparameters and trade-offs. We propose On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward (OPDVR), a simple yet effective method that seamlessly combines OPD and RLVR without adding any hyperparameters. We first reformulate the implicit reward of sampled-token OPD based on trajectory correctness, then apply a ReLU gating mechanism to ensure that correct trajectories receive non-negative rewards and incorrect ones receive non-positive rewards---thereby aligning the distillation signal with task success while preserving the teacher's distributional guidance. Furthermore, our modification transforms sampled-token OPD into a proper RLVR method, making it readily combinable with any policy gradient algorithm, such as GRPO. Experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that OPDVR consistently outperforms standard OPD. Our code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/OPDVR.
2608.24696.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習與可驗證獎勵 (RLVR) 以及在政策蒸餾 (OPD) 已成為後訓練大型語言模型的兩種廣泛採用的範式。<lb/>然而，RLVR 受到稀疏的任務級反饋的困擾，而 OPD 提供密集的標記級指導，但忽略了軌跡的正確性，限制了其性能至教師的水平。<lb/>將它們結合起來是一個有前景的方向：OPD 提供密集的監督信號，而 RLVR 提供任務級的正確性。<lb/>然而，現有的整合往往依賴於加權組合或啟發式切換，這引入了額外的超參數和取捨。<lb/>我們提出了帶有可驗證獎勵的在政策蒸餾 (OPDVR)，這是一種簡單而有效的方法，無需添加任何超參數即可無縫結合 OPD 和 RLVR。<lb/>我們首先根據軌跡的正確性重新公式化採樣標記 OPD 的隱式獎勵，然後應用 ReLU 閘機制以確保正確的軌跡獲得非負獎勵，而不正確的軌跡則獲得非正獎勵——從而將蒸餾信號與任務成功對齊，同時保留教師的分佈指導。<lb/>此外，我們的修改將採樣標記 OPD 轉變為一種合適的 RLVR 方法，使其可以輕鬆與任何政策梯度算法結合，例如 GRPO。<lb/>在六個推理基準上的實驗顯示，OPDVR 始終優於標準 OPD。<lb/>我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/OPDVR 獲得。
